text:
Evan (eng-infra): quick sync — the sidecar prototype now emits per-tenant delta metrics (token_rate, kv_cache_hits, batch_latency). thinking we can wire these into tenant-specific dashboard tiles for the console. thoughts?

Ben (eng-runtime): nice. are deltas per-request or aggregated? we need to confirm how often the sidecar flushes.

Evan (eng-infra): currently every 30s aggregate. payload is small. we can change to 10s for canary tenants.

Alice (eng-platform): two concerns: 1) privacy/compliance — don't expose raw request ids or prompt snippets in per-tenant views, and 2) multi-tenant performance: will these metrics be noisy by design?

Carla (eng-sre): add to that — alerting on noisy neighbor needs stable baselines. 30s is noisy, maybe use 1m window with 5m smoothing for alerts.

Fiona (eng-ml): for noisy neighbor detection, we should correlate token_rate spikes with model_variant and sequence_length distribution. sidecar can include `model_name` + `avg_seq_len` (no prompt text).

Diego (product): from UX side: customers should only see their org's tiles. internal admins can opt-in to consolidated view. Also want a quick 'why is my latency up' CTA that links to suggested mitigations (batching config, quantization).

Ben (eng-runtime): implementation note — we currently tag runtime requests with org_id and route_id. sidecar will emit metrics keyed by `org_id` and `route_id`. small example payload:```json
{"org_id":"org_123","route_id":"public-api","token_rate":120.5,"kv_cache_hits":45,"avg_seq_len":64}
```

Evan (eng-infra): exact payload like that. but we should hash org_id for downstream telemetry to avoid accidental leakage in shared storage. keep mapping in vault for console lookups.

Alice (eng-platform): agreed on hashing. for console we can resolve hash->org when rendering with appropriate perms. also need RBAC: tenant view vs platform-admin.

Carla (eng-sre): alert thresholds proposal: token_rate > 2x baseline for 10m OR batch_latency > 500ms p95 for 5m => noisy_neighbor tag. baseline computed per-org over trailing 7d.

Fiona (eng-ml): baseline per-org is tricky for small customers. suggest combining relative and absolute thresholds and a minimum-sample requirement.

Diego (product): UX for rollouts — when we flip on per-tenant tiles, show an in-console banner explaining sampling & smoothing. allow customers to opt into higher-fidelity (billing implications).

Ben (eng-runtime): routing policies note: if noisy neighbor detected we can route that org to a lower-throughput path or fallback model. need policy API:```yaml
policies:
  - name: noisy_neighbor_mitigation
    condition: noisy_neighbor == true
    action: route_to: best_effort_variant
```

Evan (eng-infra): infra needs to know what metrics power that rule. please list exact metric names and sampling windows so we can add ingestion pipelines.

Ben (eng-runtime): list: `sidecar.token_rate.{org_hash}`, `sidecar.kv_cache_hits.{org_hash}`, `sidecar.batch_latency_p95.{org_hash}`, `sidecar.avg_seq_len.{org_hash}`. sampling: 30s emit, 1m ingest, 5m rollup.

Grace (observability-bot): new metric family detected: sidecar.batch_latency_p95. Created alert template `noisy-neighbor-basic`.

Alice (eng-platform): follow-ups: - privacy/legal signoff for hashed org mapping (cc @legal), - UI designs for per-org tiles (I'll spin a mock), - RBAC enforcement for resolving org hashes.

Carla (eng-sre): I'll prototype alerts in staging with synthetic tenants to validate thresholds.

Fiona (eng-ml): can we add sequence-length histogram buckets? even coarse buckets (0-64,65-256,256+) will help diagnosis without exposing content.

Evan (eng-infra): yes sidecar can emit `seq_len_bucket` counts. will add to payload.

Diego (product): timeline suggestion: roadblock-free path: staging pilot next week, opt-in beta to 10 customers in 2 weeks, GA after feedback.

Ben (eng-runtime): one more thing — quotas interplay. If we throttle noisy tenant, we need telemetry events that indicate throttle reason so console can show 'throttled due to noisy neighbor' in tenant activity.

Evan (eng-infra): we'll add `throttle_reason` tags to the runtime audit stream.

Alice (eng-platform): sweet. can we capture a short acceptance checklist? I'll open a follow-up thread with tasks.

Evan (eng-infra): thanks — I'll add the sidecar schema PR and link it in that thread. :thumbsup:

Grace (observability-bot): scheduled: create dashboard template `tenant_insight_tile_v1` in staging namespace.
